stage0023_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Spectator
「Hey, you hear about it!
　That crazy $$バトリング$$ everyone's talking about!」

stage0023_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
Spectator
「Course I have!
　The biggest land weapon in $$アストラギウス$$,
　a $$地上戦艦$$'s showing up!」

stage0023_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
Spectator
「Facing them, a gang of vicious outlaws!
　Armed with cutting-edge gear stolen
　from the Federation, terrorizing dark $$バトリング$$s!」

stage0023_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Spectator
「And get this, among them
　there's a survivor from 《$$レッドショルダー$$》, they say!」

stage0023_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
Spectator
「Of course there is!
　I mean, they're called '$$レッドショルダー$$ Team'!」

stage0023_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
Spectator
「This'll be the biggest battle
　since $$ア・コバ$$ came to be!」

stage0023_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$バニラ$$
「That $$チェロキー$$,
　sure whipped up some wild hype for us」

stage0023_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It's fine, it's fine.
　I don't mind this flashy stuff either」

stage0023_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マオ$$
「We usually fight in the shadows, after all.
　Even if it's just in a lawless city,
　fighting like this is a nice change of pace」

stage0023_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Since the Balarant crowd roped the city in
　and forced unfair rules on us,
　we'll just have to crush them before a crowd」

stage0023_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Say what you want,
　but you seem to like this kind of thing, Major」

stage0023_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Not just me.
　The captain and the crew too」

stage0023_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Yeah, guess so.
　Even among $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, this kind of thing
　ain't something the others could pull off」

stage0023_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Even so, isn't that going a bit too far?」

stage0023_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$クラン$$
「Can you hear me, people of this city!
　I don't know how great this $$地上戦艦$$ is,
　but it is no match for us!」

stage0023_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$クラン$$
「If you're going to bet, bet on us!
　$$レッドショルダー$$ Team promises you victory
　and a big payout!」

stage0023_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
Spectator
「Whoaaa!
　It's a giant woman! A Zentradi!」

stage0023_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
Spectator
「I like you, lady!
　I'm putting everything on you guys!」

stage0023_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
Spectator
「S-so, please, just step on me a little!
　Just a little, step on me!!」

stage0023_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$クラン$$
（Ooh! This rush is incredible!
　The Zentradi blood in me is boiling!）

stage0023_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
Spectator
「What the, what is this thing!?
　...Is this a flyer?」

stage0023_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
Spectator
「Let's see... 'Victory to $$レッドショルダー$$ Team!'
　'Blast the gutless Balarant sky high!'
　'A $$地上戦艦$$, what's that to us!'...」

stage0023_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
Spectator
「What a spirited little rat!
　I like you!」

stage0023_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Why not. Let's settle it
　with the whole city watching,
　wrap up the mission, and rescue $$フィアナ$$」

stage0023_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ルカ$$
「...By the way, why is $$ボン太くん#robot$$ here...?」

stage0023_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アルト$$
「How should I know about Bonta!」

stage0023_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$クラン$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$アルト$$!
　That's $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　Say 'kun', you forehead dummy!」

stage0023_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...!
　Fine then, I'll go wild in the $$バトリング$$ too!」

stage0023_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Tomorrow's finally the day, our $$レッドショルダー$$ Team
　faces off against Balarant in the $$バトリング$$」

stage0023_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Once your machines are serviced,
　get plenty of rest」

stage0023_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$n
「But this name, '$$レッドショルダー$$ Team',
　couldn't something be done about it?」

stage0023_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$キリコ$$ came up with it himself.
　It's to provoke the man who took $$フィアナ$$」

stage0023_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, we can't very well
　bring up the names $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ or $$ミスリル$$」

stage0023_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Momentum's what matters in this kind of thing.
　Hyping up the rivalry gets all of $$ア・コバ$$ fired up」

stage0023_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That way, the Balarant crowd
　won't be able to pull any dirty tricks either」

stage0023_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Still, this isn't a fight
　easy enough to win on momentum alone」

stage0023_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カナリア$$
「For the sake of visibility to spectators,
　only land-combat machines may join the fight...
　That's the rule they proposed」

stage0023_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「In other words, an excuse to kill
　the Valkyrie's mobility and keep the Quarter out」

stage0023_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アルト$$
「And they've got that rumored $$地上戦艦$$.
　So they're absolutely confident in land combat」

stage0023_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「While we're without our carrier,
　so the Valkyries and Monsters
　are forced to fly low...」

stage0023_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Still gonna do it, though, right?」

stage0023_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Of course.
　To rescue $$フィアナ$$,
　we'll crush them here, completely」

stage0023_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$キリコ$$'s the key to this fight, after all.
　That $$ニーバ$$ at the enemy's core
　is bound to be gunning for him」

stage0023_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So how about it, $n?
　I hear $$キリコ$$ named you his partner」

stage0023_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「I've got no idea what he's thinking」

stage0023_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$n
「I know.
　I've got no intention of forgiving
　those who used such cowardly tactics either」

stage0023_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's fine, $n.
　You've got more than enough right
　to be $$キリコ$$'s partner」

stage0023_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$マオ$$
「He's helping $$キリコ$$ modify his AT.
　Not that I think he's much help, though」

stage0023_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$n
「Maybe he's awakened his volunteer spirit, President?」

stage0023_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アルト$$
「Not him, of all people... no way」

stage0023_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Alright, $$キリコ$$!
　This side's about done!」

stage0023_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I see.
　I'll handle the finishing touches」

stage0023_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「But was it really alright,
　painting the shoulder red...」

stage0023_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$キリコ$$
「This way, he'll be pleased too」

stage0023_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「If you say so, then I suppose that's fine...」

stage0023_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$宗介$$
（I hear $$キリコ$$ loathed his past
　as a member of $$レッドショルダー$$...）

stage0023_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$宗介$$
（Yet he still went and painted his shoulder red,
　for that woman's sake...）

stage0023_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$バニラ$$
「Good work, $$宗介$$, you too.
　You're sortieing too, so get some rest」

stage0023_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... I intend to keep $$キリコ$$ company」

stage0023_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Heh... when did you two get so close?」

stage0023_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well, fine.
　Anyway, we're gonna go get some rest now」

stage0023_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$バニラ$$
「We're betting on you lot.
　Make us some money tomorrow」

stage0023_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ココナ$$
「Night, $$ゴウト$$, $$バニラ$$.
　I'll stay with $$キリコ$$ a bit longer...」

stage0023_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ココナ$$
「What, $$シャッコ$$?
　Trying to get between me and $$キリコ$$?」

stage0023_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「That's not it.
　Just let $$宗介$$ and $$キリコ$$ have some time alone」

stage0023_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Because that's what $$宗介$$ wants.」

stage0023_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ココナ$$
「I don't get it, but
　seems like you got dragged in by $$キリコ$$ too.」

stage0023_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$バニラ$$
「When that surly guy gets moving,
　for reasons I can't explain,
　folks around him can't just stand by.」

stage0023_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Not that we can talk,
　we're dragged-in types ourselves.」

stage0023_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Then, $$宗介$$... I'll leave the rest to you.」

stage0023_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宗介$$
「Won't you customize the 《$$ミッションディスク$$》?」

stage0023_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I made this once already, fighting a $$ＰＳ$$ before.
　Nothing better could be asked for.」

stage0023_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$宗介$$
「Stripped of excess armor,
　pushed to the limit in mobility and agility...」

stage0023_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$宗介$$
「To face an AT with that kind of absurd power,
　you'd have to go this far, I suppose.」

stage0023_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$キリコ$$
「...Do you need something from me?」

stage0023_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$宗介$$
「But the way $$アルト$$ put it irks me.
　So I'll be watching what you do.」

stage0023_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's not all.
　I owe you one, from the Hanka Autonomous Region.」

stage0023_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't worry about it.
　That was just the job.」

stage0023_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't like leaving debts unpaid.
　So I intend to repay it in tomorrow's $$バトリング$$.」

stage0023_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$宗介$$
「I didn't expect to hear thanks from you.」

stage0023_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$宗介$$
「I suppose so.
　...I have dried meat.
　Want some?」

stage0023_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll take some.
　The work still needs a bit more time.」

stage0023_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll stay with you.
　That's why I stayed behind, after all.」

stage0023_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$...
　I'm going back to being $$レッドショルダー$$ now.
　To save you, so we both live on...）

stage0023_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Kill or be killed...
　That old familiar tension was racing
　through my body again after so long...）

stage0023_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$キリコ$$
（But at the same time, somewhere in me,
　I felt that I was different from back then...）

stage0023_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Now I have something I didn't have then.
　It's you, $$フィアナ$$... you and my comrades...）

stage0023_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「$$レッドショルダー$$!
　Crawling out here just to save a woman!」

stage0023_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「Don't come out, $$キリコ$$!
　This man is only fighting to kill you!」

stage0023_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Hahahaha!
　Too scared of hitting the woman to shoot!?」

stage0023_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Then I'll be the one to shoot!」

stage0023_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「How pathetic, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　Left the woman behind and ran!?」

stage0023_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「But it's pointless!
　Run wherever you like, I'll hunt you down!」

stage0023_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I've got you cornered, $$レッドショルダー$$!
　This game of tag ends here!」

stage0023_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Going to beg for your life?
　Not that it'll do you any good!」

stage0023_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「A heartless $$レッドショルダー$$ like you,
　don't think that'll save you now!」

stage0023_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Given up, have you!?
　Faster than I expected, too!」

stage0023_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「Now, I'll finish you off!
　$$レッドショルダー$$!」

stage0023_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「This music... did you set this up?」

stage0023_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$キリコ$$
「On my signal, my comrades play it from outside.」

stage0023_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「The $$レッドショルダー$$ march...
　A wound in $$ニーバ$$'s memory that won't fade...」

stage0023_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$キリコ$$
「This man could never escape his past hell...」

stage0023_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「But you're different...
　You're not $$レッドショルダー$$ anymore.」

stage0023_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ニーバ$$
「I-I won't die!
　I'll... I'll get $$レッドショルダー$$!!」

stage0023_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$n
「Your AT and the $$ジェニオン$$...
　Miss $$スズネ$$... is watching them...
　No complaints... right?」

stage0023_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$n
「Come on, let's go.
　No need to linger in a place like this.」

stage0023_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$n
「Or should we finish off that
　monster sleeping over there?」

stage0023_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$フィアナ$$
「Thank you.
　I'm safe because of you」

stage0023_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$n
「...It's just something I did on my own...」

stage0023_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$宗介$$
「Major, the ones behind them are...」

stage0023_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「The Balarant unit operating in
　$$ア・コバ$$ were $$マーティアル$$ believers」

stage0023_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I've heard of them.
　$$アストラギウス$$'s biggest religious sect, they say...」

stage0023_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's right.
　Their creed centers on strife, claiming it is
　the cosmic truth that evolves mankind」

stage0023_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So believing in such a violent religion
　is how $$アストラギウス$$ can wage war for 100 years, huh?」

stage0023_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$マオ$$
「Cut it out, $$クルツ$$.
　Religion is a delicate subject」

stage0023_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「But Sergeant Weber's point isn't
　necessarily wrong, either」

stage0023_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Many $$マーティアル$$ believers are said to
　exist among Gilgamesh and Balarant brass alike」

stage0023_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Because of that, some units reject
　the Earth Federation, founded on peace」

stage0023_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$オズマ$$
「And one of those is the Balarant at $$ア・コバ$$...」

stage0023_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So they were making killers like $$ニーバ$$
　as offerings to $$マーティアル$$'s god...?」

stage0023_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$マオ$$
「They might have kidnapped $$フィアナ$$ too
　to use $$ＰＳ$$ technology for something」

stage0023_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「The AT that took her is a machine
　piloted by someone who holds a special
　rank within the $$マーティアル$$ Order」

stage0023_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$n
「Now that we know who's behind it,
　let's go get her back」

stage0023_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$マオ$$
「Calm down, both $n and Sousuke.
　We're up against a huge religious group」

stage0023_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I hear that $$マーティアル$$'s believers now
　reach beyond just $$アストラギウス$$'s people,
　spreading across this whole world」

stage0023_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$マオ$$
「I get how you feel.
　But making an enemy of them
　takes real resolve, that's all」

stage0023_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「First, we gather information.
　If possible, I want to rescue her before
　she's moved to $$マーティアル$$'s inner circle」

stage0023_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「They surely don't want the abduction
　made public either. If we can handle this
　early, it may not grow too large」

stage0023_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ココナ$$
「That's right!
　We finally got $$フィアナ$$ back once already!」

stage0023_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Dog 1, I won't allow reckless action.
　You're one of $$ミスリル$$'s own now」

stage0023_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$マオ$$
「The major's right.
　Acting recklessly will just put them on
　guard. For now, we wait for intel」

stage0023_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$ゴウト$$, we're setting out to pursue that AT,
　but we'd like you to keep gathering
　information here in $$ア・コバ$$」

stage0023_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Leave it to me.
　$$アストラギウス$$ folks gather here, after all.
　We'll pick up word on $$マーティアル$$ too」

stage0023_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ココナ$$
「I'm in too, $$キリコ$$!
　I'll do anything to save $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0023_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$バニラ$$
「No need to be so distant with us now」

stage0023_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ココナ$$
「That's right!
　We care about $$フィアナ$$ too, you know!」

stage0023_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
???
「...If you're after $$マーティアル$$, I'll help too」

stage0023_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As for $$マーティアル$$, I have some idea,
　though only a little」

stage0023_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Amid my comrades' murmuring, my heart grew cold...」

stage0023_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$キリコ$$
「$$マーティアル$$... the god of war...
　War still hadn't let go of me and $$フィアナ$$」

stage0023_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Today, with my fight as $$レッドショルダー$$ over,
　I felt my fate being swallowed
　into a new battle...」

stage0023_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$キリコ$$
「And then, the words the mysterious AT
　pilot spoke, 'Untouchable'...
　those stuck fast in my mind」

stage0023_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$キリコ$$
「As a new battle drew near, I...
　was gripped by a dark premonition that
　peace might never come to us...」

stage0023_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, Master $$シャッコ$$?
　Is it truly so unpleasant, being stuck
　traveling with us from now on?」

stage0023_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course.
　I, $$ＡＧ$$, am confident in reading people」

stage0023_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you don't mind, would you tell me why?
　Perhaps I could be of some help」

stage0023_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「She is... what Quentian calls an abnormal」

stage0023_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... I recall Quentians
　hated abnormals so much, they rejected
　the machine civilization they'd built」

stage0023_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Strictly, that woman isn't a Quentian
　abnormal... but I sense the same scent in her」

stage0023_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「And that woman is after $$マーティアル$$...
　this can't be mere coincidence」

stage0023_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　so Master $$シャッコ$$ suspects a link between
　this string of incidents and Master $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$」

stage0023_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「...That woman deserves trust.
　The last battle proved that much」

stage0023_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「But the unease in me won't fade...
　and it's turning into irritation」

stage0023_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「I don't want extra trouble in the unit.
　Keep this matter strictly to yourself」

stage0023_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood.
　Still, even so, Master $$シャッコ$$...」

stage0023_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is the first time Master $$シャッコ$$'s
　talked this much. Am I your type, perhaps?」

stage0023_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...My apologies.
　I seem to have gotten carried away」

stage0023_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, back to the main job!
　Let's get fired up today too, business, business!」
